name: HARIBIT
summary: HARIBIT is a Beijing robotics developer incubated from Beijing Institute of Technology. It develops and supplies robot systems, motion control technology and components such as motors, reducers and integrated joints. Its portfolio includes special-purpose humanoids, quadruped inspection robots and mobile manipulation platforms. The company targets demanding field environments as well as research, industrial and service applications.
